answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a bonded stake escrowed on a public terrace of attestations, where a velvet-smooth reputation curve rewards sustained honest participation over fresh pseudonyms. Like fatigue-crack forensics tracing a relic blade to its casting lot, provenance proofs link every agent to a verifiable hardware or lineage root. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
